fileImport.title: Import calendar file
fileImport.description: The preview does not change any data. Maximum 4 MB and 2,000 events or series.
fileImport.series: Recurrences remain a series. Existing events are unchanged; importing again creates additional entries.
fileImport.legacy: Older imports without a batch cannot be identified safely. They will not be removed automatically.
fileImport.removeConfirm: Move {{count}} events / series from “{{name}}” to the trash? Other events are kept. They can be restored for 30 days.
fileImport.invalid: This ICS file cannot be imported safely. Check its format, size (max. 4 MB), UIDs and recurrence rules.
fileImport.failed: The change failed. No unconfirmed data was deleted. Please try again.
fileImport.scheduleLocked: The imported schedule is protected. Change its dates or recurrence in the original calendar file and import again. Text, category and LX reminders apply to the entire series.

warnings.alarms: Some alarms are preserved but cannot trigger in LX (for example email, after the end, or more than a week before).
warnings.otherComponents: Other calendar components such as tasks are not imported. Please keep the original file.

header.description: Automatically pull in events from Google, Outlook, Nextcloud and other ICS calendars.

form.connectHint: The link stays encrypted on your server.
form.syncModeTwoWay: Two way – LX may write events
form.visibilityHint: Choose every profile that should be assigned events from this source.
form.colorConflict: {{color}} is already used by {{names}}. Using the same colour can make the calendar confusing.
form.privacyNote: Read-only: the family planner cannot change or delete anything in the external calendar. Still, never share the secret link publicly.
form.caldavPrivacyNote: Read-only: username and app password are stored encrypted only on your LX server. LX never changes or deletes anything in the CalDAV calendar.
form.caldavTwoWayNote: Two way: LX imports changes and writes your local events to this one calendar. LX does not remotely delete foreign events; simultaneous edits create a visible conflict copy.

reminderDialog.note: Notifications must be enabled once in each profile. The notice also appears in the family inbox.
